QuestInfo.name: What Larelle Said
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta found #p2430000# locked away in a cave, but his tale wasn't one of imprisonment. They went to #b#MDmap323090200##k to talk to him some more.
QuestInfo.1: #p2430000# told the duo a tale of guilt and sadness, and asked them to deliver a final goodbye to #b#p2430001##k for him to thank the people of Henesys for all the love they had shown him.
QuestInfo.2: When the duo returned to #p2430000# with #p2430001# 's kind words, he finally smiled. His short time in #m323000000# had touched his heart.

speech.0: Mark told me you were coming to rescue Larelle. You'd better not harm a hair on his head! That little boy is a good boy. He didn't mean to hurt those people. We were trying to keep him safe.
speech.1: Larelle said he was s-sorry? What a... brave little... champion! Oh no... here come the waterworks. Please... leave. I'm an explosive crier.

0.0: I'm so sorry to ask, but could you tell #bStan#k that I'm really sorry for leaving him? I-I just don't want to leave without saying goodbye. These people have been so good to me.
0.1: I don't think there will ever be a place I love as much as this. I hope I can come here again, when the people will be safe from my powers.
